bench.build_cmd: cd /w && mkdir -p /tmp/gen && sed 's/${project.version}/2.8.6/' gson/src/main/java-templates/com/google/gson/internal/GsonBuildConfig.java > /tmp/gen/GsonBuildConfig.java && mkdir -p gson/target/classes && javac -nowarn -source 1.7 -target 1.7 -encoding UTF-8 -d gson/target/classes $(find gson/src/main/java -name '*.java' ! -name module-info.java) /tmp/gen/GsonBuildConfig.java 2>&1 | grep -v '^Note\|warning' ; true
bench.run_cmd: cd /w && rm -rf /tmp/tcb && mkdir -p /tmp/tcb && javac -cp gson/target/classes -d /tmp/tcb {task}/bench/TCBench.java && java -cp gson/target/classes:/tmp/tcb com.google.gson.internal.TCBench {size} {repeat} {mode}
